# Harvard Law School Journals

> A collection of peer-reviewed academic journals covering business law, corporate governance, and financial regulation from Harvard Law School.

Harvard Law School publishes multiple specialized journals that serve as authoritative sources for legal scholarship and analysis. These journals feature articles from leading academics and practitioners on contemporary issues in business organization, capital markets, securities law, and related fields.

## Key Topics

- Harvard Business Law Review
- Corporate Law
- Capital Markets
- Securities Law
- Financial Regulation
- Business Organization
- Bankruptcy Law
- Academic Legal Scholarship

## Primary Journals

- [Harvard Business Law Review (HBLR)](https://journals.law.harvard.edu/hblr): Premier journal on business organization, capital markets, and corporate law
